# importing necessary libraries
library(readr)


#---
#title: "R Notebook"
#output: html_notebook
#---

#load dataset
floodnet_df <- read_csv("FloodNet__Street_Flooding_Events_Measured_by_FloodNet_Sensors_20261016.csv")

#view the few rows of data / summary of data
head(floodnet_df)
str(floodnet_df)
summary(floodnet_df)

#plot
hist(floodnet_df$"Maximum Flood Depth (inches)",
        main = "Maximum Flood Height Detected \n (All Rain Events & Sensor Readings) \n Nov. 2020 - Oct. 2026",
        xlab = "Flood Depth (in.)",
        ylab = "Occurence",
        col = "blue",
        border = "skyblue"
     )
